findings.evidence: Finite-horizon hard-terminal counterexample and stationary loss calculation
Missing objective enforcement and unstated Markov/comparison/transversality hypotheses
Smooth wrong-limit sequence with vanishing population squared HJB residual
Merton parameter substitution; globally binding no-short-sale control has no stated wealth switching boundary
Constructed DDPG plotting curve, out-of-range constrained-policy data, and missing replication implementation in inspected tree
Negative marginal consumption utility in stated gamma=5 regime
TD derivative sign error, zero-target fallacy, and mismatch between TTSA conditions and constant-step Adam
State-domain issue, utility-parameter derivative, cardinal normalization, and unsupported identification inference
Fixed-shadow-price consumption margin and incompatible supplementary equations
Joint-objective versus unilateral-gradient distinction, static Cournot witness, and missing exploitability certification
Separable capital-stock benchmark, unmatched error/hardware definitions, and unisolated contribution relative to neural PDE methods
Variance term in expected squared residual and Gaussian scalar minimizer counterexample

limitations: This is not an actual journal-appointed referee report or editorial decision.
No authenticated prior referee-response round was present in the inspected repository.
The report examines manuscript equations and figure source, not a compiled PDF or unused PNG renderings.
Successful reviewer diagnostics do not constitute successful NBO solver tests or reproduction of author experiments.
No inference about author intent is made from the documented figure-provenance mismatch.
The conventional Epstein-Zin consumption calculation is a formal stationary candidate, not an infinite-horizon verification theorem for the stated parameters.

change_policy.scope: Only new files under the review directory on the new review branch
